chapter: Sam Morgan band: records, slapstick, venues
title: More on the Casinos hall, and when Morgan moved across the river
summary: Back on hall names, Morgan places the Casinos on Elmira Street, says he moved over in 1953 and suggests others to ask.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I found the sheet I was looking for, but it doesn't have the name of that place on. I was trying to think of the name of the hall.
Name of the hall across where you used to it?
Yeah, near the Elks. We're over on Elmira, in the 1200 block of Elmira.
I think that was the Cassianers, if I'm not making a...

Yeah, okay. There's still another name that Fess told us and somebody else had mentioned once too. Kid Thomas mentioned the name of the hall over there and it's still one we haven't mentioned yet. I just can't think of it. It's in my mind, but I just can't get a hold of it.
This hall, I'm trying to think now because... Around Elmira there. It was on Elmira Street. At that time, if I'm not making a mistake, Mr. Russell, it was the Casinos.
Casinos.
Yeah. You may ask Kid Thomas about that because I played several dances there with Thomas Mann at the time.
Was it on a corner or in the middle of the block?
It was just about the second house from the corner. Upstairs.
Upstairs.
Yeah.
Some of the other things that we took pictures of were the Manhattan Saloon of Newton and Teche. Do you remember when it was the Manhattan Saloon? It's...
Well, I would have been, but I...
That's before your time over there too, I guess.
Yeah. Yeah, it was because I've been living over the river now just about... I've been living over there about seven going into the eight years now. So I moved over then.
Do you remember a place called Elmira Pleasure Ground? No. Or Perseverance Pleasure Ground. It used to be up where that pumping station is in there now.
No, I don't know very much about over there because...
When did you move over there by the way?
In 53. Well, you only moved over in 53. Yeah.
I thought maybe you lived there for years.
No, no. I used to live here in the city of New Orleans. Over in here. Yeah. Because several of you men came by my house when I was living on 919 St. Peter Street. Yeah.
And you wouldn't have known all of these old places then that...
No, I don't know very many old places over in Algea or Gretany.
There were some places like the Pythian Hall and the Alhambra Club that Fess told us about.

No, I think that was before my time. It was before your time. Now, I'll tell you a fellow you might get a little information on it. Peter Bocca. Yes, Peter would know. Yeah. Either Manuel Mineta or Kit Thomas.
Yeah, well, the Fess told us this several things. We were just wondering about a couple of places we weren't sure of there.
Uh-huh.
